*🛡️Tropical Rain Destabilises Oceans Only When Light* 

 *💎Key Findings* 
♟️Scientists earlier believed rain makes the ocean’s surface more buoyant (due to freshwater being lighter)
♟️New study (Univ. of Washington, July 2025) finds light rain destabilises the ocean, but heavy rain stabilises it

 *💎Mechanism* 
♟️Rain in tropics often comes with cold pools (cold, dry air + clouds)
♟️These cool the surface, block sunlight & transfer heat to air
♟️Thus, heavier rain makes surface cooler and more stable
♟️Light rain (0.2–4 mm/hr) increases mixing, while heavy rain = negative buoyancy flux (surface stays more stable)

 *💎Additional Observations* 
♟️Rainfall at night destabilises oceans more than during the day
♟️Researchers identified:
 *⚜️Cold Rain Zone* (W. Pacific & Indian Ocean): High heat loss
 *⚜️Hot Rain Zone* (Central Pacific): Less heat loss

 *💎Impact on Climate* 
♟️Ocean mixing affects carbon, heat, nutrient transport
♟️Rainfall dynamics influence weather and climate models
♟️Study highlights risk of prediction errors due to simplistic assumptions.

The new RRB PO/Clerk Notification is expected within the next 25 days, with 31 August 2026 being the most likely date.
Candidates are advised to stay prepared and keep checking for the official notification.
Follow for verified updates, exam notifications, and preparation resources.

10 August 2026 Current Affairs in Hindi & English

➼ Air Marshal Sandeep Thareja को Director General Armed Forces Medical Services (DGAFMS) नियुक्त किया गया।
Air Marshal Sandeep Thareja has been appointed as the Director General Armed Forces Medical Services (DGAFMS).

➼ Ashish Yadav ने Eugene, USA में आयोजित World Athletics Under-20 Championships 2026 में पुरुषों की Javelin Throw स्पर्धा में Silver Medal जीता।
Ashish Yadav won the Silver Medal in the men’s Javelin Throw event at the World Athletics Under-20 Championships 2026 held in Eugene, USA.

➼ Odisha ने 16th Hockey India Junior Men National Championship 2026 (Division ‘A’) का खिताब जीता।
Odisha emerged as the champion in the 16th Hockey India Junior Men National Championship 2026 (Division ‘A’).

➼ Mumbai को अगस्त में होने वाले BRICS Friendship Cities Conclave 2026 की मेजबानी के लिए चुना गया।
Mumbai was announced as the host for the BRICS Friendship Cities Conclave 2026 scheduled for August.

➼ IIT Delhi के Sonipat Campus में Param Pragya नामक AI-powered High-Performance Supercomputing Facility का उद्घाटन किया गया।
An AI-powered High-Performance Supercomputing Facility named Param Pragya was inaugurated at IIT Delhi’s Sonipat Campus.

➼ Vietnam 2026 में Miss World के 75th Anniversary Edition की मेजबानी कर रहा है।
Vietnam is hosting the 75th Anniversary Edition of Miss World in 2026.

➼ Mongolia ने बहुपक्षीय संयुक्त सैन्य अभ्यास KHAAN QUEST 2026 की मेजबानी की।
Mongolia hosted the multilateral joint military exercise KHAAN QUEST 2026.

➼ India और USA की नौसेनाओं के बीच Explosive Ordnance Disposal (EOD) Exercise 2026 आयोजित किया जा रहा है।
The Explosive Ordnance Disposal (EOD) Exercise 2026 is being conducted between the Indian and US Navies.

➼ Puducherry Police को उनकी बहादुरी और समर्पण के लिए President’s Colours से सम्मानित किया गया।
Puducherry Police was awarded the President’s Colours for its bravery and dedication.

➼ भारत की BRICS अध्यक्षता के तहत 11th BRICS Culture Ministers’ Meeting का आयोजन Bhopal में किया गया।
The 11th BRICS Culture Ministers’ Meeting was held in Bhopal under India’s BRICS Chairmanship.

➼ विदेशों में छिपे 274 भगोड़े अपराधियों को भारत वापस लाने के लिए केंद्र सरकार ने Operation Trishul शुरू किया।
The Central Government launched Operation Trishul to bring back 274 fugitive criminals hiding abroad under assumed names and identities.

➼ Australia ने बहुराष्ट्रीय वायु सेना अभ्यास Pitch Black 2026 की मेजबानी की।
Australia hosted the multinational air force exercise Pitch Black 2026.

➼ Sonai Rupai Wildlife Sanctuary Assam में स्थित है।
The Sonai Rupai Wildlife Sanctuary is located in Assam.

➼ नई पौध प्रजाति Begonia neelamorum का नाम Nyishi Tribe के Neelam clan के नाम पर रखा गया है।
The newly discovered plant species Begonia neelamorum was named after the Neelam clan of the Nyishi Tribe.

➼ Gujarat के Rathwa tribal community की पारंपरिक Pithora Painting को Geographical Indication (GI) Tag प्रदान किया गया।
The traditional Pithora Painting of the Rathwa tribal community of Gujarat has been granted a Geographical Indication (GI) Tag.
